LESSON: EXPLORING WEATHER

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and 1.1 Weather and Sky By the end of the sub-strand,  Learners to 
Topic 1.1.2: Exploring weather

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Exploring weather
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How is the weather today?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify weather (windy, cloudy, rainy and sunny) conditions of the day  In groups, learners to observe

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Exploring weather

Teach
• Observe Exploring weather in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Exploring weather (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Exploring weather.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Exploring weather.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Exploring weather.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify weather (windy, cloudy, rainy and sunny) conditions of the day  In groups, learners to observe

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Exploring weather.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Exploring weather: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is the weather today?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify weather (windy, cloudy, rainy and sunny) conditions of the day  In groups, learners to observe

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
